extension.summary: InputStream client with audio tempo control (pitch-corrected playback speed)
extension.description: InputStream client based on FFmpeg with built-in audio tempo processing. Supports pitch-corrected playback speed from 0.5x to 100x for audiobooks and podcasts. Based on inputstream.ffmpegdirect.
extension.news: v22.3.11 Renumbered to Kodi's add-on versioning: the first number is now the Kodi version a build is for, so 22.x.y is Kodi 22 (Piers) and 21.x.y is Kodi 21 (Omega). The add-on itself is unchanged from v0.3.11 — only the numbering and the build system moved. Kodi 21 and Kodi 22 now build from separate branches and release separately.

extension.news: v0.19.1 - Pad lyrics directory tail so kofin lyrics can draw them correctly
extension.summary: Jellyfin client for seamless Kodi integration
extension.description: Play movies, shows & music from a Jellyfin server.

extension.news: v22.14.0 - Fixed live channels failing to play whenever a maximum streaming bitrate was set: the add-on offered the server its own decoding codecs as transcode targets, so the server pinned the output to the source's audio codec and then could not encode it once the bitrate cap ruled out a straight copy - "Force transcoding" now states that the video must be re-encoded instead of trying to provoke it by sizing the stream down against the source, so it re-encodes reliably and an unlimited bitrate no longer has its figures rewritten - New Advanced setting: turn off SSL certificate verification, for servers with a self-signed certificate. It covers the add-on's own requests (login, guide, timers, recordings); video playback is handled by Kodi and the inputstream add-ons and is unaffected - "Reset resume position" now works on recordings. Watched state and resume position are sent to the server as separate, explicit requests rather than told apart by their timing, so resetting a resume point can no longer flip the watched flag by mistake, and finishing a recording now marks it watched even when it had no resume point - Notifications now carry the Kofin icon when the add-on is reporting something and Kodi's own warning and error icons when something was refused or went wrong. Every notification is now translatable, and a few that were shown as errors are now warnings - A recording you are watching now tells you when it has finished recording - Maximum audio channels now defaults to 7.1 - The add-on now carries the Kofin logo
extension.summary: Kodi PVR client for Jellyfin Live TV
extension.description: Native Kodi PVR integration for Jellyfin Live TV. Provides live TV channels, EPG, recordings, and timers from a Jellyfin server with native Kodi UI integration.

extension.news: v2.2.0 - Settings are now four tabs -- General, Skin, API keys, Advanced -- with the descriptions moved out of the labels into help text. Existing settings keep their values. - Appearances as themselves are recognised however TheMovieDB spells them. The old check matched only "himself" and "herself", and only when a character was filled in at all, so it caught none of Tom Hanks' 114 documentary credits. Genuine roles are kept: named voice parts in documentaries stay. - The same filter now applies to TV credits, which were never filtered. - New settings to hide documentaries outright, and to hide releases a person did not live to see. - Posters in the Similar, Collection, Seasons, Movies and TV shows rows show the rating, drawn with the current skin's own badge. - New Skin tab with a toggle per button a skin offers for this add-on, and a new Search button among them. - Opening a page is much faster: 1.9s to 0.6s warm and 2.4s to 1.4s cold on a desktop. Most of what went was import cost paid on every single launch. - Fixed: with an OMDb key set, every movie page made three OMDb requests, cached none of them, and never filled in the retail date.
extension.summary: Embuary Info Script (Kontell fork)
Embuary Info Script (Kontell-Fork)
extension.description:
Helper script to provide The Movie DB informations for persons, shows and movies. Works best with a skin integration.
Kontell fork of sualfred's Embuary Info, maintained at https://github.com/kontell/script.embuary.info — please report issues there rather than to the original author. Fixes unbounded memory growth when browsing many pages in one session, and reduces artwork bandwidth and page-load time.

Helfer Script das Abfragen von The Movie DB informationen für Personen, Serien und Filme zu ermöglichen. Funktioniert am besten mit einer Skin Integration.
Kontell-Fork von sualfreds Embuary Info, gepflegt unter https://github.com/kontell/script.embuary.info — Fehler bitte dort melden, nicht beim ursprünglichen Autor.

extension.news: v0.2.0 • The add-on's own lyrics window now changes size in one smooth glide per song, instead of jumping to a guess and snapping to the real width moments later • Fixed a crash: Kodi can close the lyrics window by itself, and the add-on writing to the closed window could take the whole of Kodi down on the next track change. It now notices and quietly reopens • New setting for the lyrics window height, in pixels, anchored to the top of the screen — set it to keep the lyrics clear of whatever the skin draws along the bottom • Skins that draw the lyrics themselves can now size their overlay per song: the add-on publishes how wide the song's lines run, and applies the height setting to the skin's overlay where the skin supports it. Contuary 2.7 does both
extension.summary: Song lyrics from your Jellyfin server
extension.description: Shows the lyrics stored on your Jellyfin server as a song plays, in time with the music where the server has timings. Lyrics are supplied by the Kofin addon, so nothing here needs a second login. Skins that draw lyrics themselves are used in preference to this addon's own window.

extension.news: v0.3.3 • A queue interrupted by a video is put away on the track you were actually on, rather than the first one. Kodi reports the position of whichever playlist the player has moved to, so a starting video called it track 1 for several seconds while the music was still playing — the track is now taken from the file coming out of the speakers instead
extension.summary: Bring back a music queue you were part-way through
extension.description: Records the music queue every time it is taken away — when a new album replaces it, when a video interrupts it, when playback is stopped, and when Kodi quits — along with which track you were on and how far into it. Pick one back off the list and it resumes on the right track at the right second, or from the start of that track if you prefer. Reached from the "Recent queues" button on Contuary's music row, or by running the add-on.

extension.news: v1.1.0 • Home menu: generate one Movies/Shows-style section per Kofin library, bound to that library's synced Kodi nodes or live plugin paths • Skin settings entry to add, rename, re-icon, reorder and delete those sections
extension.summary: Helper script for the Contuary skin
extension.description: Switches the active <res> declaration in skin.contuary's addon.xml between configured resolution options, and generates per-library home main-menu sections from Kofin movies and TV libraries. A resolution change needs a Kodi restart; generated menu sections apply after ReloadSkin.

extension.news: v2.7.0 - Size the lyrics overlay to the song, and let the addon set its height

extension.description: Contuary is a lightly modified version of the default Estuary skin. Based on Estuary for Kodi 22 (Piers).
